inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary caregivers CPR training expired 1/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The provider was missing annual training on understanding building and physical premises safety and handling and disposing of hazardous materials.  Evaluation period was 3/25-2/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of three child files evaluated was missing an updated vaccination record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: One child was missing their health statement.    Note:  This is a recite
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver completed 22 out of 30 annual training hours for the evaluation period of 3/24-2/25.  6 hours for Child Development was missing.    NOTE:  Management training, food allergy, building safety, hazardous material and controlling the spread of communicable disease and Child Growth and Development were completed for a todal of 9 additional training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child was missing medical authorization information and one child was missing the parent signature for medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking: A three month old infant was observed in a bassinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking (26 TAC §747.2305(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A newly enrolled infant did not have an enrollment form on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: One out of four child files evaluated contained documentation that the parents received information regarding Parent's Rights.  Parent's Rights is not included in the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: Two children, age 14 and 19 months, were asleep with their bottles provided to them before nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §747.2319(6))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance: A copy of the provider's liability insurance coverage was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Liability Insurance (26 TAC §747.801(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Four out of four child files evaluated did not have the child's physician information on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission (26 TAC §747.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: The provider's people list was last validated on 6/16/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Four out of four child files evaluated did not have a health statement signed by the child's parent or from their pediatrician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Four out of four child files evaluated were missing parent authorization to provide emergency medical attention if needed.  The page of the enrollment form that contains this information was missing from the files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor and Active Play: The children are not participating in outdoor time while in care due to various boxes and personal items out in the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor and Active Play (26 TAC §747.2104(b))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver completed 13 out of 30 annual training hours for the evaluation period of 3/24-2/25.  Training topics missing included 6 hours of child development, half hour of management training, food allergy, building safety, hazardous material and controlling the spread of communicable disease.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parent rights information was not included in the provider's current operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two children were missing updated vaccination records from their 5 mos vaccination update.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infants (6 mos) did not have an updated feeing instruction on file.  The last feeding instruction was completed in February 2024.  One child (6 mos) did not have a feeding plan on file at all.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: The provider last validated the people list 3/2/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: One child was missing a health statement upon enrollment.  One child was missing a health statement from the doctor after being in attendance for 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File: An emergency diagram was not available for review.  Provider was shown a sample diagram and two exit routes should be identified was discussed.    NOTE:  This is a re-cite.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: A 5 mos old infant was observed in a bouncy seat on top of a bed surrounded by pillows.  The infant was removed immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §747.4401(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Record Upon Admission: Two out of four children did not have immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last recorded fire drill was conducted on 2/9/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: The provider failed to timely report to the parents of the 4 children in care that the provider does not maintain the required liability insurance coverage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Two out of four children in care did not have enrollment documents on file at the operation.  The provider only had phone numbers for the parents or grandparents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File: An emergency evacuation diagram was not available for inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram- Must Be On File (26 TAC §747.5007)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience: The primary caregiver did not complete 3 hours in management training for the evaluation period of 3/21-2/22,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - More Than 5 Years Experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: A current Children's Products Certification was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Household Members Qualifications - Orientation: Household member did not have documentation that an orientation was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Household Members Qualifications - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: One out of five child files evaluated did not contain the child's start date.    NOTE:  Start date for the child was obtained and entered on the enrollment form during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §747.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two out of five child files evaluated did not contain completed emergency contact information on the child's enrollment form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of five child files evaluated did not have current immunization records on file.  One child, 10 mos, was missing their 3rd DTaP, a child 32 mos was missing their Varicella vaccination.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: NOTE:  This is a recite  The primary caregiver has recorded 25 out of 30 hours of annual training for the year evaluated, 5/2021-4/2022.    Primary caregiver was missing training hours under the following topic areas and has not completed the missing training hours/topics.  :  Emergency preparedness, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, Administering medication, Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, Understanding building and physical premises safety, and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 5 child files reviewed were missing current immunization records. Note:  This citation is a recite as the children are still missing documentation for missing immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: A 4 mos, who enrolled in  January 2022, did not have a health statement signed by the parent or physician due to the enrollment application was missing this information when the parent enrolled.    Note:  This is a recite.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 5 child files reviewed were missing current immunization records. Primary caregiver was missing training hours under the following topic areas:  Emergency preparedness, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations, Administering medication, Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction, Understanding building and physical premises safety, and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §747.2319(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))
